facts.fact: Algérie Zoom reports the Direction Générale du Domaine National said Amlak was designed and developed in one year by its own staff and IT teams, and announced its generalisation to all cadastre, land conservation and state property offices on 11 January 2026.
Algérie Zoom reports the Direction Générale du Domaine National credits its own cadres, agents and IT teams, under a steering committee, with Amlak, and names no contractor.

Algérie Zoom reports the Direction Générale du Domaine National generalised the Amlak information system to all its cadastre, land conservation and state property offices on 11 January 2026, giving immediate answers to counter requests.
Algérie Zoom reports Amlak is a unified national system joining cadastre, land conservation and state property functions on one central national database.
Algérie Zoom reports the Direction Générale du Domaine National generalised the Amlak system, with a central national database for cadastre and land conservation, on 11 January 2026.
Algérie Zoom reports the generalisation of Amlak covers all local directions of cadastre, land conservation and state property, without exception.

DZA.note: The electronic land booklet is not yet launched, so nothing online is stated.
